backup.production_rule: Take a fresh database backup immediately before apply. Storage: the guest-id-photos bucket held 0 objects on 2026-09-14 (storage.objects count), so no object backup is needed for this apply; if the pre-apply count is not 0, back the objects up first (no script exists yet) because the policy change alters how existing objects are read. Four function bodies replaced with identical signatures; bucket limits and three storage policies replaced; grants restated. No rows or objects rewritten.

forward_verification.name: audit_feed_guest_branch_scoped
forward_verification.query: select prosrc like '%v_guest%' from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'admin_audit_feed_v1'

forward_verification.name: merge_preview_scopes_both_guests
forward_verification.query: select prosrc like '%guest merge scope denied%' from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'preview_guest_merge_v1'

forward_verification.name: merge_locks_and_refuses_enriched_source
forward_verification.query: select prosrc like '%for update%' and prosrc like '%Review the source profile and companions%' from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'merge_guests_v1'

forward_verification.name: profile_save_validates_reason_and_links
forward_verification.query: select prosrc like '%profile change reason required%' and prosrc like '%invalid Drive document link%' from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'save_guest_profile_v1'

forward_verification.name: bucket_limits_set
forward_verification.query: select file_size_limit = 10485760 and cardinality(allowed_mime_types) = 3 and public = false from storage.buckets where id = 'guest-id-photos'

forward_verification.name: photo_policies_property_scoped
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 3 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'storage' and tablename = 'objects' and policyname like 'guest id photos%' and coalesce(qual, with_check) like '%foldername%'

forward_verification.name: authenticated_can_run
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.merge_guests_v1(uuid, uuid, text, text)', 'execute') and has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.save_guest_profile_v1(uuid, jsonb, integer, text)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: anon_cannot_run
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.merge_guests_v1(uuid, uuid, text, text)', 'execute')

rollback.safe_until: always - function bodies, bucket limits and policies only; no data touched. Prefer a forward fix because the rollback widens ID-photo access again.

feature_flags.name: guest_profile_extras
feature_flags.required_state: admin-dashboard guest CRM changes (uncommitted at packaging time) already validate reasons, links and photo types client-side; the legacy UI is not affected because it never called these RPCs.

compatibility.evidence: Every preserved union branch and signature diffed equal to the live definitions on 2026-09-14. Behavioural changes are intentional refusals: name-only or enriched-source merges, reasons under 3 chars, non-Drive/Messenger links, future birthdays, null expected version on a profile past version 1, photo objects outside a companion path, non-image or >10 MB uploads. Rehearsed 2026-09-14 by Lloyd on backup set cascade-supabase-20260914T092826Z: migration applied, 8/8 forward checks, pgTAP 28/28, table count unchanged.
